hero: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide cinematic hero painting for an elegant Chinese-language mythology roleplaying game anthology. A seamless richly detailed panorama of a fantastical ancient world at twilight: distant misty Chinese mountain temple and narrow jade peaks transition naturally into Mesopotamian sandstone ziggurats, a Greek broken column on rocky coast, a weathered Celtic stone arch and distant northern snow peaks, all sharing the same sea and dramatic dusk light. Subtle silhouettes only, no famous copyrighted characters. Painterly realism and fine etched textures, quiet ink charcoal / deep peacock teal / aged copper and warm golden horizon. A thin huge bronze celestial ring partly visible behind clouds provides visual unity. Landscape 3:1 composition, right two-thirds contain main spectacular landmarks and lit coastline; left one-third darker uncluttered mist for text overlay. Avoid collage cutout seams, icon grids, neon, bright blue, decorative frames. No text, letters, symbols that resemble text, logos, UI, or watermark. Mature illustrated collector's book quality, compelling atmosphere with strong depth and actual place, not generic abstract texture.
